title: DTS: Delta-Based Tile Scoring for Efficient Long-Context Sparse Attention
abstract: arXiv:2611.25938v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly need to process long documents and codebases, making long-context attention a major prefill bottleneck. Block sparse attention reduces computation by skipping unimportant blocks of the attention matrix, but scoring blocks accurately can itself be expensive. We propose Delta-Based Tile Scoring (DTS), a training-free, content-adaptive tile scoring method for sparse block attention. DTS selects query and key anchors according to local vector changes, using fewer representatives in redundant regions while retaining more detail in heterogeneous regions. To accelerate anchor selection, parallel delta packing partitions the query and key sequences into tile-aligned chunks and performs bounded local scans over these chunks concurrently. The selected tiles are then computed using the original query, key, and value vectors. On LLaMA-3.1-8B-Instruct, DTS keeps average RULER and LongBench scores within 0.10

translated_title: DTS：基于增量变化的瓦片评分方法，实现高效的长上下文稀疏注意力
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）越来越需要处理长文档和代码库，这使得长上下文注意力成为预填充阶段的主要瓶颈。块稀疏注意力通过跳过注意力矩阵中不重要的块来减少计算量，但准确地对块进行评分本身可能代价高昂。我们提出了基于增量变化的瓦片评分方法，这是一种无需训练、内容自适应的稀疏块注意力瓦片评分方法。DTS 根据局部向量变化来选择查询和键的锚点，在冗余区域使用更少的代表性元素，同时在异构区域保留更多细节。为了加速锚点选择，并行增量打包将查询和键序列划分为与瓦片对齐的块，并并发地对这些块执行有界局部扫描。选定的瓦片随后使用原始的查询、键和值向量进行计算。在 LLaMA-3.1-8B-Instruct 上，DTS 将平均 RULER 和 LongBench 分数保持在 0.10 以内（摘要在此处似乎被截断）。
tldr: 提出了一种无需训练、内容自适应的瓦片评分方法 DTS，它根据局部向量变化选择查询和键锚点来高效评分稀疏注意力的块，并在冗余区域少选、异构区域多选锚点以兼顾效率与精度，从而在几乎不损失模型长上下文性能的前提下显著降低长上下文预填充的计算开销。
en_tdlr: DTS is a training-free, content-adaptive tile scoring method that selects query and key anchors based on local vector changes to efficiently score blocks for sparse attention, substantially reducing long-context prefill computation while keeping accuracy nearly on par with dense attention.
